name: canonical_sequence_holdout
question: Do narrow attached/spaced final-chain variants share held-out context beyond matched nulls?

grammar.primary_note: k=2 finals (stem + two finals); k>=3 secondary/exploratory

holdout.reveal_policy: computed once after development is finalized; no post-reveal tuning

context.stream: per-folio ordered strict-token stream, consumed chain tokens removed

metrics: primary: mean over qualifying chains of weighted Jensen-Shannon divergence between fused and spaced context distributions
decision_rule: H008 supported iff N1 p<0.05 AND N2 p<0.05 AND leave-one-chain-out keeps N1 p<0.10; underpowered (<3 chains) => INCONCLUSIVE
claim_ceiling: Variable structural attachment only; no morphology/semantics/plaintext claim.
